messages:
Ethan Park: Hey team, just unboxed my laptop + dock. Dock boots but one of the rear USB-C ports looks slightly bent and the monitor won't get signal when plugged into that port. Tried two cables. Ticket IT-4999 created. Anyone seen a bent USB-C port in a shipment before? :grimacing:

Maya (IT): Sorry about that, Ethan. Tagging self on IT-4999. Can you take a close pic of the port and the serial on the dock? If it's a physical damage we'll swap it. Quick check: does the front USB-C port work for video or only power?

Ethan Park: Serial on dock: RD-DOCK-21-8791. Front USB-C only powers laptop, no display over it. Rear bent port photo: https://imgur.com/ghi789. HDMI->DP cable works when plugged into laptop directly. No spare dock in box.

OnboardingBot: IT-4999 assigned to Maya (IT). Replacement dock reserved from inventory (priority swap). Courier pickup scheduled today. ETA on-desk tomorrow.

Olivia (Facilities): Hey Ethan, I can drop by with a USB-C cleaning tool and a spare USB-C cable to try if you want to test before we swap. Desk 2C-07?

Ethan Park: Yes desk 2C-07, appreciate it. Tried a compressed-air blast and a thin pry with a toothpick (careful) 0  No change. If you bring a spare cable happy to test.

Maya (IT): One more ask: can you run `sudo dmesg | tail -n 30` after you plug the monitor into the rear port and paste the last 10 lines? If the kernel reports a USB port error that's helpful for RMA. If not comfortable sharing logs here DM me.

Ethan Park: Pasted last lines: "usb 3-2: new SuperSpeed USB device number 7 using xhci_hcd
usb 3-2: device descriptor read/64, error -32
usb usb3-port2: couldn't allocate usb_device
Type-C: port partner: usb_device not enumerated". Happy to DM logs if you prefer.

Maya (IT): That error suggests physical/electrical issue. I'll mark dock DOA and schedule pickup. Olivia, please pick up the damaged dock when you drop the spare cable. I'll update IT-4999 with RMA steps and ship the replacement.

Olivia (Facilities): Copy that. I'll swing by 4pm to trade the dock and leave a note with the replacement's serial. Ethan, I'll bring a spare cable too so you can re-test.

Ethan Park: Thanks everyone! Appreciate the fast help and the trade. Looking forward to being fully set up :smile:
